name: Magnetic Pull
tags: magnetic cursor spring pointer physics hover rAF button
note: A requestAnimationFrame velocity spring pulls the button toward the pointer while label and arrow trail at lower parallax multipliers.
html: Pointer inside the field pulls the target

name: Gooey Merge
tags: gooey svg-filter metaball blur colormatrix orbit queue button
note: An feGaussianBlur plus high-contrast feColorMatrix alpha ramp welds orbiting blobs into the pill as metaballs, with the filter id generated at runtime so copies never collide.
html: Queue empty

name: Liquid Wave Fill
tags: liquid wave fill svg-path css-only hover label-clip button
note: Two looping SVG wave paths ride the top edge of a height-animated fill while a bottom-anchored clip layer swaps in a dark label copy exactly as the liquid passes it.
html: Hover or focus to pour

name: Particle Burst
tags: canvas particles physics click burst gravity additive button
note: A DPR-aware canvas overlay spawns a gravity-and-drag particle system from the exact click point, drawn additively and torn down the frame the last spark dies.
html: 0 cheers sent

name: Self-Drawing Border
tags: stroke-dashoffset svg pathlength offset-path toggle aria-pressed border
note: A pathLength-normalised SVG rect draws its stroke via stroke-dashoffset while a glow dot rides the identical rounded-rect through offset-path, looping once the toggle is armed.
html: Border draws on hover

name: Text Scramble
tags: scramble decrypt text randomize monospace hover rAF button
note: Each character gets its own randomised start and settle frame, cycling junk glyphs in a rAF queue until the label resolves left-to-right.
html: cipher idle

name: Chromatic Glitch
tags: glitch rgb-split chromatic clip-path scanline steps pseudo-element
note: Duplicate labels drawn with content:attr() are split into red and cyan channels whose clip-path bands and offsets are re-randomised on a 90ms timer while hovered.
html: RGB split · scanline sweep

name: 3D Extruded Press
tags: 3d extrude press perspective rotatex box-shadow counter tactile
note: Stacked hard box-shadows fake the extruded side wall, collapsing to 1px as the face translates down under perspective rotateX with an overshoot release curve.
html: 3 credits
